capabilities: Run shell commands from bash code blocks
Stop a running command and its child processes
Show command output below the block
extras: Desktop only. Commands run with Obsidian's permissions, with no confirmation dialog and no sandbox.
problem: Obsidian notes cannot run shell commands, so scripts kept in notes have to be copied out and run in an external terminal.
summary: Adds a run button to bash code blocks that executes the shell command and shows its output below the block.
